recognize_zh: 大量大型芽細胞取代骨髓，核圓或略凹陷、染色質細緻並可見核仁，細胞質中等量深藍色，部分有核旁淡染區與小空泡；配合 t(8;21) 的 FISH 結果，符合具成熟傾向的 AML with RUNX1::RUNX1T1。此解析度下 Auer rods 不明顯。
features: Sheets of large blasts with moderate N:C ratio replacing normal elements
Round to indented or notched nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin and visible nucleoli
Moderate to abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm, some with a paler perinuclear (Golgi) zone
Scattered small cytoplasmic vacuoles in several blasts; Auer rods not clearly resolved at this magnification
A single degenerating/smudged cell near the lower center; scant mature granulocytes
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is effaced by a population of large blasts in a background of red cells. The blasts have round to indented nuclei with fine chromatin and nucleoli, and moderate to abundant basophilic cytoplasm with occasional perinuclear pale zones and small vacuoles. Auer rods are not clearly resolved in this field, and residual maturing granulocytes are scant. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia; with the demonstrated t(8;21), they are consistent with AML with RUNX1::RUNX1T1.

ddx.vs: Monoblasts have gray-blue, more abundant cytoplasm with folded nuclei and are nonspecific esterase positive, whereas t(8;21) blasts are strongly MPO positive with a perinuclear hof and salmon-colored granules.
Inv(16) AML shows myelomonocytic blasts with abnormal eosinophils containing large basophilic granules, and it is separated from t(8;21) by cytogenetics.
Lymphoblasts have scant agranular cytoplasm and are MPO negative with CD19/CD10/TdT, although t(8;21) AML may aberrantly express CD19 and PAX5, so full flow cytometry is needed.
APL cells are hypergranular with bundles of Auer rods and PML::RARA, unlike these blasts with relatively agranular basophilic cytoplasm.
